name: git
description: Run sandboxed git commands on the project. Input: {"args": ["status", "--porcelain"]}. Allowed: status, diff, log, show, add, commit, ls-files, rev-parse, branch, worktree. push, reset, rebase, checkout, clean, rm, fetch, merge, revert, stash are denied by default; setting agent.git_remote_ops lifts push, merge and checkout for git. Git global options that take a value (-C <path>, --git-dir <path>, --work-tree <path>) are honored, so per-worktree operations work: git -C .local/worktrees/<wt> add/commit/push <branch>. Returns {"ok": bool, "code": int, "stdout": "...", "stderr": "..."}.
